lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co4Pb2W4O20 (reduced formula Co2PbW2O10) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows cobalt centers in octahedral coordination by six oxygen atoms, while lead centers adopt a 10-vertex coordination environment and tungsten centers show four oxygen neighbors. Oxygen atoms bridge cobalt and tungsten, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include edge-sharing between Co octahedra and corner-sharing between Pb and Co polyhedra.
